page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number at top right. Signature and catchword at foot. No marginal notes beyond small marks.

main_text.p: conftet perspecta morbi natura, probos omnes viros vulneri remedium expetere, quod & reperire utilius sit, & vero facilius, quam de procellarum iflarum authoribus convenire.

Cuilibet Christianæ fidei rudimentis imbuto notum esse, noftrum in præcipuis doctrinæ capitibus confsum, præsertim in gratuita peccatorum remissione per Christi sanguinem Æterni Dei filii & unius generis humani Mediatoris, omnibus in ipsum credentibus parta; unde fit ut iisdem rationum & argumentorum telis Antichristi Romani præstigiás & errores oppugnemus; in ipsoque adeo cœnæ negotio, de quo præcipua disputatio est, de Sacramenti substantia conveniamus, cum nemo sit qui se verum corpus Christi in Eucharistia assumere diffiteatur; cum itaque nulla superfit controversia, nisi in ipso percipiendi modo, intolerandum esse, ut in eo quæ- rendo nullum plane modum adhi- bea-

page.notes: Page is printed with the running head "Reg. Gall. ad Imp. &c." and page number 421 at top right. Some letters are blurred; "conftet", "fufficit" and the Greek-free text read as printed. Marks at the foot (S 7) are a signature and the catchword "bea-" sits at the right.
